description: For every supplied eleven-rule native cut-free tree of \(\Gamma\Rightarrow C\) and covering split \(\Gamma\subseteq L\cup R\), the specified structural recursion returns the actual native middle formula and both cut-free factor trees with their common-atom bound. It tests left membership first, reverses the designated implication and negation antecedent splits, and recurses only on original strict premise trees.
